# Reference profile READMEs

Curated, real-world profile READMEs that `github-glowup` uses as a quality bar. Add one file per example:

```
examples/<style>-<short-name>.md
```

Each file should contain the source link and the author's handle at the top, the README Markdown (or the relevant excerpt), and one line saying what makes it good. Only add READMEs whose authors publish them publicly. Credit is required.
